summary: A mobile application designed to help farmers manage their daily agricultural operations, track crop cycles, and monitor weather conditions.
assumptions: The app will be available on both iOS and Android platforms.
Users will have intermittent internet connectivity in rural fields, requiring offline data caching.

requirements.text: Users can create an account using their email address and secure password.
Users can add crop details including planting date, field location, and expected harvest time.
Users can log daily farm activities such as irrigation, fertilization, and pest control.
Users can view local weather forecasts based on their registered field locations.
95% of weather data requests complete in under 2000 ms.
All user passwords must be securely hashed using modern cryptographic algorithms.

epics.title: User Authentication and Security
epics.description: Handles user registration and secure account management.

epics.title: Crop and Farm Management
epics.description: Enables farmers to track crops, field locations, and daily activities.

epics.title: Weather and Platform Quality
epics.description: Provides weather forecasts and ensures performance standards are met.

stories.i_want: to create an account using my email address and secure password
stories.so_that: I can access and protect my farm data
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration screen, when I enter a valid email and strong password, then my account is created successfully.
Given an existing email, when I try to register again, then an error message is shown.

stories.i_want: all user passwords to be securely hashed using modern cryptographic algorithms
stories.so_that: user credentials remain protected against breaches
acceptance_criteria: Given a user password submission, when it is saved to the database, then it is hashed using a strong algorithm like bcrypt or Argon2.
Given stored passwords, when inspected directly, then plain text passwords are never visible.

stories.i_want: to add crop details including planting date, field location, and expected harvest time
stories.so_that: I can keep track of my crop cycles
acceptance_criteria: Given the crop creation form, when I fill in planting date, location, and harvest time, then the crop is saved.
Given missing mandatory fields, when I submit, then validation errors are displayed.

stories.i_want: to log daily farm activities such as irrigation, fertilization, and pest control
stories.so_that: I can maintain a historical record of all field operations
acceptance_criteria: Given the activity log interface, when I select an activity type and submit, then it is recorded against the specific crop.
Given past activity logs, when I view my crop details, then I can see the chronological list of activities.

stories.i_want: to view local weather forecasts based on my registered field locations
stories.so_that: I can plan my daily farming activities accordingly
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered field location, when I open the weather section, then I see the local forecast.
Given an invalid location, when fetching weather, then a graceful fallback message is displayed.

stories.i_want: 95% of weather data requests to complete in under 2000 ms
stories.so_that: users receive timely weather information without noticeable delay
acceptance_criteria: Given the weather API service, when load testing is executed, then 95% of responses return within 2000 ms.
Given slow network conditions, when requests exceed the threshold, then performance metrics log the event.

tasks.title: Create users table schema
tasks.description: Create the database migration for the users table storing email, hashed password, and timestamps.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Standard database table schema creation with indexes.

tasks.title: Implement register-user endpoint
tasks.description: Build backend registration endpoint to validate inputs, handle duplicate emails, and create the user account.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Single backend endpoint with input validation and creation logic.

tasks.title: Build user registration screen
tasks.description: Create the frontend registration view with email and password inputs and error message display for existing emails.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Frontend form for registration with standard validation.

tasks.title: Write registration tests
tasks.description: Implement automated tests for successful user creation and duplicate email error handling.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Unit and integration tests for the registration flow.

tasks.title: Implement secure password hashing service
tasks.description: Integrate bcrypt or Argon2 hashing utility to securely hash user passwords before storing them in the database.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Implementation of standard password hashing service using bcrypt or argon2.

tasks.title: Write password security tests
tasks.description: Add unit and integration tests to verify that plain text passwords are never stored or exposed in the database.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Security tests verifying hash strength and proper implementation.

tasks.title: Create crops table and schema migration
tasks.description: Create the database schema for crops including planting date, field location, and expected harvest time fields.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Database table and migration for crops with foreign keys.

tasks.title: Implement create-crop endpoint
tasks.description: Build the backend endpoint to validate and store new crop details with mandatory field checks.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Backend endpoint to handle crop creation.

tasks.title: Build crop creation form UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend form for farmers to input planting date, location, and harvest time with validation error displays.
tasks.estimate_rationale: UI form for entering crop details and planting dates.

tasks.title: Test crop creation and validation
tasks.description: Write automated tests for crop creation endpoint and frontend form validation rules.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Tests covering crop creation and validation rules.

tasks.title: Create farm activities table and schema migration
tasks.description: Create the database schema for logging daily farm activities linked to specific crops.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Database schema and migration for logging activities.

tasks.title: Implement create-activity endpoint
tasks.description: Build the backend endpoint to record daily activities like irrigation, fertilization, and pest control against a crop.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Backend endpoint for logging farm activities.

tasks.title: Build activity log interface
tasks.description: Create the frontend view allowing farmers to log activities and view the chronological history for crop details.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Interface to display and create daily farm activity logs.

tasks.title: Test farm activity logging
tasks.description: Write tests verifying activity logging and chronological list retrieval for crop operations.

tasks.title: Implement weather forecast integration
tasks.description: Integrate external weather service API to fetch local forecasts based on registered field locations and handle graceful fallbacks for invalid locations.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Complex third-party external API integration with error handling and caching.

tasks.title: Implement get-weather endpoint
tasks.description: Create backend endpoint to retrieve weather data for a given field location and return appropriate fallback messages.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Backend endpoint to fetch and transform weather data.

tasks.title: Build weather section UI
tasks.description: Develop the frontend weather section to display local forecasts for registered field locations and handle fallback message rendering.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Frontend weather widget and UI display.

tasks.title: Configure performance monitoring for weather API
tasks.description: Set up monitoring and logging to track weather data request latencies and flag events exceeding the 2000 ms threshold.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Devops task configuring APM and monitoring rules.

tasks.title: Execute load testing for weather requests
tasks.description: Run automated load tests against the weather service to verify that 95% of responses complete in under 2000 ms.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Load testing scripts and execution for performance benchmarks.

dependencies.reason: Backend endpoint needs the users table schema.
Password hashing service integrates with the user model.
Frontend registration screen calls the register endpoint.
Registration tests need the UI and backend ready.
Security tests require the hashing service implementation.
Crop endpoint requires crops table schema.
Activity endpoint needs the activities table and foreign keys to crops.
Crop creation form UI calls the crop creation endpoint.
Crop tests validate the end-to-end creation flow.
Activity endpoint needs the activities table and foreign keys to crops.
Activity log interface calls the activity endpoint.
Activity tests require the activity log interface and backend.
Weather endpoint relies on weather forecast integration.
Weather UI calls the get-weather endpoint.
Performance monitoring requires the weather endpoint to monitor.
Load testing uses performance monitoring configuration.

risks.title: Sprint Overload and Lack of Buffer
risks.description: According to the capacity plan, 1 of 2 sprints is packed to at least 98% of capacity, leaving no buffer for estimation error.
risks.mitigation: Reallocate tasks out of the overloaded sprint or reduce scope to create a safer buffer for estimation errors.

risks.title: Capacity Expansion Relative to Critical Path
risks.description: The capacity-feasible plan requires 20 working days across 2 sprints compared to a critical path minimum of 10.5 working days, resulting in a ratio of 1.88x.
risks.mitigation: Review resource allocation and task scheduling to bridge the gap between the critical path and the capacity-feasible plan duration.

risks.title: Critical Path Concentration
risks.description: The critical path duration is 64 hours (10.5 working days) where 4 of 19 tasks, or 21 percent, are critical.
risks.mitigation: Monitor the critical tasks closely and ensure sufficient resources are assigned to prevent any delays on the critical path.
